items.exampleEn: Some people don't wear fur because they love animals.
items.exampleZh: 有些人因為愛護動物而不穿皮草。

items.exampleEn: She wore a long blue gown to the party.
items.exampleZh: 她穿了一件藍色長禮服去參加派對。

items.exampleEn: He forgot to shave this morning.
items.exampleZh: 他今天早上忘了刮鬍子。

items.exampleEn: She keeps her jewels in a small box.
items.exampleZh: 她把珠寶放在一個小盒子裡。

items.exampleEn: The baby was born almost bald.
items.exampleZh: 那個寶寶出生時幾乎沒有頭髮。

items.exampleEn: The bracelet makes a sound when she moves her hand.
items.exampleZh: 她一動手，手環就會發出聲響。

items.exampleEn: Be careful; this razor is very sharp.
That cafe is a fashionable place for young people.
items.exampleZh: 那家咖啡店是年輕人愛去的時髦地方。

items.sentenceEn: Many men become bald as they get older.
items.sentenceZh: 很多男性年紀越大頭髮越少。

items.audioEn: She wore a long blue gown to the dinner, and everyone loved it.
items.audioZh: 她穿了一件藍色長禮服去參加晚宴，大家都很喜歡。

items.sentenceEn: The cat's fur is soft and white.
She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
items.sentenceZh: 她總是穿時髦的衣服上班。

items.stemEn: He uses an electric ____ every morning.
items.stemZh: 他每天早上用電動刮鬍刀。

items.stemEn: My uncle went ____ in his thirties, so he always wears a hat.
items.stemZh: 我叔叔三十幾歲就禿頭了，所以他總是戴著帽子。

items.passageEn: Every year, the city museum holds a show about clothes in history. This year, visitors can see a long silk gown from a hundred years ago, covered with small jewels. There is also a coat made of real fur, which is no longer fashionable today. One room shows how men used to shave, with old razors and soap. The gift shop sells copies of old bracelets. Prices are relatively high, but I bought one for my sister.
items.passageZh: 每年，市立博物館都會舉辦一場關於歷史服飾的展覽。今年，參觀者可以看到一件一百年前的絲質長禮服，上面綴滿小珠寶。還有一件真皮草做的外套，那在今天已經不流行了。有一個展間介紹男人以前怎麼刮鬍子，展出舊刮鬍刀和肥皂。禮品店賣仿古手環。價格相對高，但我還是買了一個給我妹妹。

questions.questionZh: 那件長禮服有什麼特色？
作者在禮品店買了什麼？

referenceEn: This hat is very fashionable now.
This kind of hat is fashionable these days.
rubricZh: fashionable 表示「時髦的」，例如放在 be 動詞後、名詞前等
主詞單數，be 動詞用 is

items.instructionZh: 用 bracelet 造一個句子，說說你或你家人戴的手環。
referenceEn: My sister always wears a silver bracelet.
I got a bracelet from my best friend.
rubricZh: 時態配合內容（例如 wears、got）
